2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead on sector returns (+2.20% 1W; +9.01% 1M), followed by Industrials (+1.44%; +1.22%) and Materials (+1.40%; +5.01%). Stock leaders include LMT (1W: +13.54% | 1M: +20.25%), ABOVE TREND, and DOW (1W: +10.07% | 1M: +21.12%), ABOVE TREND; individual utility-stock performance was not provided.

Watch for stabilization in META (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -13.34%), BELOW TREND, and BA (1W: -11.70% | 1M: -8.79%), BELOW TREND; a continued negative week would reinforce weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Relative strength is concentrated in LMT (1W: +13.54% | 1M: +20.25%), ABOVE TREND, and TXN (1W: +11.21% | 1M: +10.99%), ABOVE TREND. Major 1W/1M divergences and weak Communication remain key risks; PSX’s positive earnings sentiment conflicts with its weekly price decline at PSX (1W: -7.73% | 1M: +5.91%), CORRECTION.
